shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,110p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -a && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Modal Button DropdownMenu && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg -n -C 3 'Navigation|navigation|Icons' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Modal Button DropdownMenu && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg -n -C 3 '## Navigation|## Icons' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@2 @gravity-ui/icons@2'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts && sed -n '1,165p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@3 peerDependencies --json && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && rg -n 'sorting|sort' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js && rg -n -- '--g-table|--g-text-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -35"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@3 @gravity-ui/icons@2'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,95p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && rg -n 'value|onUpdate|options|label|size|placeholder|filterable' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && node -p 'require(\"@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json\").version' && sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg 'AsideHeader.*d.ts|types.d.ts|INDEX.md' | head -15 && rg -n 'export.*(Persons|Person|Magnifier|ArrowDownToLine|Plus|Gear|Bell|Chart|House|CircleQuestion|Calendar|Folder|ArrowUpRight|Sliders|Chevron|ArrowRightFrom)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && rg -n -- '--gn-|--g-color-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -35 && rg -n 'Person|Magnifier|Gear|House|CircleQuestion|Folder|Sliders|CircleCheck|Envelope|Xmark' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && rg -n 'semantic|brand|success|utility' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -85 && rg -n -- '--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader | head -35 && sed -n '130,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && sed -n '1,65p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader && rg -n -- '--gn-aside|--gn-composite|--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/*.css | head -45 && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
s=''.join(p.read_text() for p in Path('node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm').glob('*.js'))
print('\\n'.join(sorted(set(re.findall(r'--(?:gn|g)-(?:aside|composite|menu|navigation)[\\w-]*',s)))))
PY
sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -75"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from \"fs\"; const s=fs.readdirSync(\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm\").filter(x=>x.endsWith(\".js\")).map(x=>fs.readFileSync(\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/\"+x,\"utf8\")).join(\"\"); console.log([...new Set(s.match(/--(?:gn|g)-(?:aside|composite|menu|navigation)[\\w-]*/g))].join(\"\\n\"))'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-color-(?:base|text|line)-(?:positive|success|info|utility|warning|misc|neutral)[\\w-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/Item/Item.d.ts | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts && rg -n 'Theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts && rg -n 'subheaderItems' src/App.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '145,205p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js && rg -o -- '--g-color-base-generic-ultralight|--g-color-text-light-primary|--g-spacing-7|--g-border-radius-xl' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u && git diff --stat"
